tei:div.tei:p: // rgyab mdun rlung 'jug thur ma'i man ngag bzhugs so//

bde chen 'khor lo'i rang zhal dbu ma'i klong*// thabs shes steng 'og rlung gi zlos gar las// sku gsum mchod byed gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin pa// zung 'jug mnyam nyid he ru ka la 'dud// mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma yal zhing*// tshe gcig 'ja' lus sgrub pa'i thabs| |rgyab mdun thur ma'i man ngag rnams// kho bos gsal bar 'dir dgod kyi// snod ldan rnams kyis 'di longs shig /rtsa 'dab gzhung dmigs 'khrul 'khor la// byang zhing chub par byas nas cing*// thog mar rgyab rlung sbyangs nas ni// kha zas rags pa spang byas te// bdun sogs zhag grangs ran par rigs// dbu ma ka 'dzugs bslabs nas cing*// steng rlung mnan zhing 'og rlung gis// lus gnad brang pus sprad byas te// rkang mthil sar phab 'phongs bteg nas// srin zhal rig gcus zhal phye nas// dbu ma ka 'dzugs shed kyis drang*// de'i tshe hika ces sgra 'byung ste// rlung lam 'byongs pa'i rtags yin pas// zhal gdams 'bebs la brtson pa bskyed// mi bskyod lcag gis yang yang bskul// zas snyigs myur du 'bud par 'gyur// zas gting yod na na zug 'byung*// snyigs ma med rtags mi bskyod pa// rang gi mdog can byung na'o// de nas mkha' lding rgyal po yi// myur byed dag pa tshad ran bya// bdar legs byas pas bcud kyis byug /mkhyid gang bi ṭi bu gar bcu+ug /mi bskyod rang drod mnyam pa la// sne gtad lus gnad sngar ltar la// ka ba gcig pas drang por sbyor// de'i tshe mchod pa myur du 'byung*| |de ltar 'byongs tshe mi bskyod pa'i// sku tshab kok+ke bcu+ud ldan pa// sngar bzhin mchod pas mi 'tsho na// srin po rak+sha mnyes la bzhag |des ni mchod pas 'tsho bar 'gyur// de 'dra zhag grangs du byed kyang*// shin tu 'byongs pa gal che'o// rjes la gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar| |bdud rtsi mar khu drang bar bya// de nas kha zas gtong ba na// rim bzhin chung ngus goms su bcug

/spyod lam gzab la zas bza' zhing*// gdon dang grib la 'dzem par bya| |'di ni lag len bsdus pa ste// bā yu lam sbyang dmigs pa dang*// mi bskyod pa yi sgom bzlas sogs// rtsa 'dab zab khrid gzhung du gsal// snod min rnams la gsang bar bya| |de ni rgyab rlung rlung 'tsho yi// man ngag lag len zhib rgyas bcas// re zhig grub par bgyis pa yin// sa ma ya/ kha thaṃ/ rgya rgya rgya: da ni mdun rlung srog thur la// rnam pa gnyis yod rang lus dang*// gzhan lus lde mig thabs ldan lam// thog mar rang lus lde mig gi// thabs ldan srog thur bsre ba bstan// thog mar gdan legs la 'dug ste| |sems skyil sked pa bsrang bya zhing*// lag g.yas lha mo'i pad+mar bsam// dal bus rdo rje bskyod la bsgreng*// de'i tshe bde ba g.yos pa'i tshe// ma smin tsam la lag pas bsdam| |nyi zla gyen bgrod ka ba btsugs// pho rlung stod sgril 'dren par bya// de nas 'dre rdo nag ril gyis// mi bskyod lam mchog byang bar sbyang*// de'i rjes gro sog sbubs btsugs la// phu btab ka ba gcig pas drangs// 'byongs rtags lbu ba rtsi rtsi 'byung*// de nas sbug btsugs lgang bu bskyon// rlung dgang ka ba gcig pa yis| |'dren zhing phyi nas lgang bu btsir// 'byongs rtags btsir ba mi dgos par// lgang bus rlung rnams 'jug par 'gyur// de nas lgang bu phud nas kyang*// sog sbug ka ba gcig sbyor gyis// rlung la shin tu byang bar bya// de nas smyug gam lcags sbug gi// thur ma tshad ldan btsud byas la// mi bskyod pa la sne gtad nas// ka ba gcig pas 'dren par byed/ */de 'byongs mi bskyod dhū rgyu gnyis// bsres la drangs pas dhū rgyu 'byong*// mi bskyod shul du lus nas 'ong*// de nas mi bskyod rak+ta bsre// drangs pas rak+ta 'drongs nas kyang*// mi bskyod rgyal po bzhugs par gyur// 'di rnams lus gnad sems skyil la// cung zad bsgur la rgyab rlung 'then// ka ba gcig pas drang ba'o// thur ma rgyab tshe khrag 'dzag na// 'brug rus 'bri mar sbyar la byug

/khams dang mi bskyod mi thub na// 'brug rus 'bri mar kho nas sbyar// rdo rje tsha zhing sbrid pa dang*// skrangs sogs byung na sdig srin dang*// se 'bru sbyar ba'i khu ba de// rdo rje'i nang bcug de yis sel// rgyab mdun bcud mi 'tsho ba la// 'brug rus pad rag ga pur gsum// zhib btags chu la sbyar byas nas// mdun rgyab sgo nas drangs pa na| |bcud dang sa bon 'tsho bar 'gyur// rlung gis mi bskyod mi 'greng na// lgang bu'i nang du mi bskyod blug /ka ba gcig pas nang nas 'dren// lag pas phyi nas rim bzhin 'ded| |des ni myur du 'byong bar 'gyur// 'byong tshe lgang bu mi dgos so// de tshe dkar 'dren rtags 'don dang*// dmar 'dren rtags 'don gzhung ltar bya// de nas rjes gcod gzhung du gsal// 'di ni rang lus lde mig gi /thabs ldan srog thur bsre ba'o// 'di la rab tu 'byongs nas kyang*// gzhan lus thabs ldan lde mig ni// mo 'khrid lam 'bras dag la 'bad// 'di ni gnad 'gag shin tu che// 'di yis ma sbyang thabs lam par// bu tsha bu mo mang po 'byung*// 'jig rten pa las sdig ltung che// 'di la goms stobs byung ba na| |nyin gcig rig ma stong rol kyang*// srid pa byung na kho bos bslus// zhes pa'i thabs lam zab mo 'di// snod ldan re re ma gtogs pa// kun la bstan na chos srung dang*/ */ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis chad pa chod// sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya: / dha thim/ khaṃ thaṃ/ a thaṃ/ zhes rgyab mdun rlung 'jug thur ma'i man ngag 'di nyid kyang*/ mched grogs 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba'i ngor/ lam 'di nyid nyams su blangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ dharma kīrtis shing yos sa ga zla ba'i dga' ba phyi ma la/ shar kaḥthog pa'i sa'i thig le hor pho zam kha'i sgar du bris pa'o// //maṅga laṃ//
